description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the LeavePeriodHistoryService in the OrangeHRM project. It tests various functionalities related to generating and retrieving leave periods based on historical settings and date calculations.

classes.name: LeavePeriodHistoryServiceTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing LeavePeriodHistoryService functionalities, including generating leave periods and identifying the current leave period based on date.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment and prepares necessary data fixtures.

methods.name: testGetGeneratedLeavePeriodListDateIsNotSet
methods.description: Ensures that calling getGeneratedLeavePeriodList with null as a parameter throws a ServiceException.

methods.name: testGetGeneratedLeavePeriodListDefineAs2012Jan1st
methods.description: Tests leave period generation from a historical start date set to Jan 1, 2010, asserting the correct list including dynamic extension based on current year.

methods.name: testGetGeneratedLeavePeriodListDefineAs2010Jan1st
methods.description: Similar to above but with an initial start date of Jan 1, 2010, and checks the generated list.

methods.name: xtestGetGeneratedLeavePeriodListForLeapYear
methods.description: Disabled test (indicated by 'x') intended to verify correct leave period generation around leap years.

methods.name: testGetGeneratedLeavePeriodListDefineAs2010Jan1stAnd2012Jan1st
methods.description: Tests multiple historical start dates to verify cumulative leave period list generation.

methods.name: xtestGetGeneratedLeavePeriodListCase1
methods.description: Disabled test for generating leave periods based on varying historical start dates across years.

methods.name: testGetCurrentLeavePeriodByDate
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the current leave period for given dates.

methods.name: convertLeavePeriodArrayToYmdArray
methods.description: Helper to convert an array of LeavePeriod objects into arrays of start and end dates as strings.

methods.name: convertLeavePeriodToArray
methods.description: Helper to convert a LeavePeriod object into an array of start and end date strings.

methods.name: getLastDayInFebruary
methods.description: Returns the last day of February for a given year, accounting for leap years.
